newsitem.title: USA: Dart to buy remaining stake in chain.
newsitem.headline: Dart to buy remaining stake in chain.

text.p: Dart Group Corp. said Wednesday that Kenneth Herman had accepted its offer to buy for $210 million in cash the half interest in Shoppers Food Warehouse Corp that he and his family own.
Dart, which owns the other half of the company, said the deal could close within 60 days.
Shoppers Food Warehouse Corp. is a regional supermarket chain with 34 stores operating in the greater Washington, D.C. metropolitan area.
For its fiscal year ending June 29, Shoppers reported total sales of $836 million and net income of $18.9 million.

On Monday, Dart said it offered to either buy the 50 percent stake in Shoppers Food it does not already own for $210 million in cash, or sell its 50 percent stake for the same price. Dart said that under an amended shareholders' agreement, Herman had to accept one of Dart's offers within 60 days.
